title: LexThesis: An Open Toolkit for Doctoral Legal Research
description: LexThesis: an open toolkit for law PhD students. Legal footnotes, tables of authorities, research integrity records, Groningen guidance, Overleaf support and tested thesis layouts. This deposit preserves a dated source snapshot of the implementation and documentation, with the limitations stated in the repository.
notes: MIT applies to original toolkit code. This independently authored toolkit is not an official university template or endorsement. Archival publication does not establish peer review, independent validation or production readiness.
